# Requirements Quality Checklist: Recitation Queue System

**Purpose**: Review F-003 requirements for completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, and coverage before task generation
**Created**: 2026-08-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by `/speckit.checklist`. It evaluates the quality of the written requirements and design contracts, not implementation behavior.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are round preparation, activation, reset, and finalization requirements defined for both scheduled and active F-005 session states? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK002 Are eligibility requirements complete for explicitly pre-ordered students, currently present students, absent active students, late joiners, removed members, teachers, and supervisors? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the supported manager controls—reorder, move, advance, start, skip, complete, reset, correction, opt-out decision, and policy change—each assigned an unambiguous requirement outcome? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, §FR-007, §FR-012, §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements present for grading-optional completion, including whether grade omission and later correction are allowed? [Gap, Spec §FR-007, §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK005 Are opt-out requirements complete for request creation, duplicate requests, decline, approval, automatic approval, a reciting requester, and manager-role loss while a request is pending? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK006 Are grade/note projection requirements defined for queue snapshots, realtime events, reconnect recovery, historical rounds, and every visibility policy? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, §FR-009, §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK007 Are audit requirements complete for policy changes, opt-out requests/decisions, skips, resets, turn transitions, completion, and grade/note corrections, including which records must be durable? [Gap, Spec §FR-005, §FR-012, §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK008 Are requirements defined for prepared-order visibility and editing before entries are materialized under `present_at_activation`? [Gap, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK009 Is “eligible student” defined using exact membership, role, presence, removal, and session-state criteria at both preparation and activation time? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the deterministic fallback order clear when only some eligible students have a manager-defined pre-set position or multiple joins share a timestamp? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK011 Is “move” distinguished clearly from complete-list reorder, including which entries may move while another entry is reciting or selected? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the durable meaning of “advance selects” explicit, including selection replacement, no-waiting-entry behavior, and interaction with an existing reciter? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK013 Is “without penalty” defined as no grade, no progress/practice record, no negative status derivation, and retained neutral audit history? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the difference between prospective workflow-policy changes and immediately effective visibility projections explicitly stated? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK015 Is “durably logged” distinguished from structured operational audit logging so retention and queryability expectations are unambiguous? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-005, §FR-012, §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK016 Are timeout, retry, retry-exhaustion, and reconciliation timing requirements quantified for media control, outbox delivery, and ended-session cleanup? [Gap, Plan §Phase 1]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK017 Are the five queue-entry states consistent across the specification, data model, REST schemas, WebSocket catalog, and architecture state machine, with round/request lifecycles clearly separate? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK018 Are the four round types, five grades, and five closed policy dimensions identical across product decisions, specification, data model, and canonical contracts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, §FR-007, §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK019 Does the separate advance/start contract remain consistent with every journey and architecture flow, with no remaining implication that grading automatically advances or completes a turn? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Plan §Phase 0]
- [ ] CHK020 Are `present_at_activation` and `all_active_students` requirements consistent between pre-set ordering, activation population, and late-join behavior? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK021 Is `preserve_last_state` consistent with terminal round finalization, no actionable reciter, and the rule that only entry states use the canonical five values? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK022 Is F-003’s at-least-once notification wording consistent with the plan’s decision that F-008—not F-003—owns Firebase device-token and FCM delivery infrastructure? [Conflict, Spec §Safety/Reliability, Plan §Phase 1 Mobile]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the planned `memorization_progress` ownership consistent with F-007’s future schema/view ownership and the prohibition on F-003 dashboards or Quran-map derivation? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK024 Are current-role authorization requirements consistent across REST mutations, realtime projections, pending opt-out decisions, session creator attribution, and mid-session role changes? [Consistency, Spec §Safety/Reliability, §FR-012]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK025 Can every invariant in SC-001 and SC-002 be measured under duplicate, concurrent, stale-version, retry, restart, and reconnect scenarios? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK026 Does SC-003 enumerate every server-validated input named by the requirements, including policy values, order membership/uniqueness, expected versions, and opt-out decisions? [Coverage, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK027 Is the “exactly one” completed-turn record criterion measurable for initial completion and every allowed correction without conflating insert and update outcomes? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004, §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK028 Is SC-005 broad enough to cover media secrets and provider identifiers in outbox metadata, audit metadata, error details, metrics labels, notification data, and client diagnostics? [Coverage, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK029 Does SC-007 define an observable convergence deadline or retry-exhaustion outcome for ended-session queue cleanup? [Gap, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK030 Does SC-008 define measurement start/end points, sample size, network assumptions, and treatment of disconnected clients for the 500 ms objective? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-008]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK031 Are alternate flows documented for an empty eligible population, a prepared round whose candidates become ineligible, and a session ending before its prepared round activates? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK032 Are conflict requirements defined for simultaneous advance/start, reset/complete, reorder/late-join, opt-out/skip, policy/action, and correction/reset operations? [Coverage, Spec §Safety/Reliability]
- [ ] CHK033 Are recovery requirements specified for database commit followed by event failure, reciter grant failure, reciter revoke failure, application restart, and missing/closed media room? [Coverage, Recovery, Spec §FR-009, §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK034 Are requirements explicit for stale or out-of-order grade visibility events after a policy change, including whether clients must discard or re-fetch? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-009, §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK035 Are requirements defined for note clearing, grade replacement, repeated identical correction, and correction attempts after each correction-policy boundary? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK036 Are round-number allocation and reset requirements defined under retries and concurrent creators so numbering remains sequential without history reuse? [Coverage, Spec §FR-001, §FR-006]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK037 Are authentication, authorization, validation, rate-limit, and audit requirements traceable to every mutating and read/projection surface rather than stated only globally? [Security, Spec §Safety/Reliability]
- [ ] CHK038 Are privacy requirements specified for student names, grades, notes, opt-out facts, and audit metadata in addition to the explicit media-secret prohibition? [Privacy, Gap]
- [ ] CHK039 Are Arabic-first, RTL, accessibility, loading, empty, offline/reconnecting, and recoverable/terminal error-state requirements complete for student and manager queue experiences? [Coverage, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK040 Are observability requirements measurable for mutation latency, conflict rate, outbox backlog, delivery lag, media convergence, cleanup backlog, and invariant violations without exposing sensitive labels? [Gap, Plan §Research 10]

## Dependencies and Scope Boundaries

- [ ] CHK041 Are the exact F-001, F-002, and F-005 interfaces/facts consumed by F-003 documented without assigning queue behavior back to those features? [Dependency, Spec §Scope, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK042 Is the transient handling of F-005’s private room reference through the existing `ReciterAudioControl` signature reconciled with the prohibition on room references in F-003 persistence, events, logs, caches, and URLs? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK043 Are F-007 and F-008 handoff requirements explicit enough that later progress and FCM work can consume stable F-003 records/events without schema or contract reinterpretation? [Dependency, Spec §FR-008, Plan §Phase 1 Mobile]
- [ ] CHK044 Are all explicit exclusions—scheduling, chat, payments, recording, video, AI assessment, timers, dashboards, auth redesign, and session/media rebuilding—consistent across spec, plan, contracts, and architecture? [Scope, Spec §FR-011]
